name: meteor-vite-app
description: Standalone Vite + Vue example: the app translates its own texts with vue-i18n and supplies French for Meteor's snippets from the same catalog.
author: shopware AG

scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:types
scripts.test:e2e: concurrently --handle-input --kill-others --success first "npm run dev" "wait-on --verbose http-get://localhost:5180/ && playwright test"
